definitions.explanation: The minimum amount of energy the body needs to maintain basic life functions at rest, such as breathing, circulation, and cell production.

examples.japanese: {基礎代謝|きそたいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{筋肉|きんにく}→筋肉：02646_kinniku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Building muscle is a good way to raise your basal metabolism.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧{基礎代謝|きそたいしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。

⟦ダイエット→ダイエット：17678_daietto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らし→減らす：02414_herasu⟧すぎる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{基礎代謝|きそたいしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちて→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧、⟦{逆|ぎゃく}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{太|ふと}り→太る：01190_futoru⟧やすく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you reduce your food intake too much when dieting, your basal metabolism drops and you actually become more likely to gain weight.

notes:
USAGE:
A common topic in health, fitness, and dieting discussions. Often abbreviated to {基礎代謝量|きそたいしゃりょう} (basal metabolic rate) in more technical contexts. The concept is widely discussed in Japanese health media.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {基礎代謝|きそたいしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (to raise basal metabolism)
- {基礎代謝|きそたいしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (to have a high basal metabolism)
- {基礎代謝|きそたいしゃ}⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧ (basal metabolic rate)
